The diff was reviewed line by line; nothing else moved. relay (bots v4 Phase A4) is the `relay` turn-context section, line by line, that a relayed turn (a token with a relay claim) adds in the role teammate's own thread: who is talking. Its stable prompt does not move. Captured from that code and reviewed line by line.
